title: Distributed Training using an Intelligent Network
abstract: arXiv:2608.26453v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Distributed training across a wide area network (WAN) is challenging, as continuous parameter exchange by islands of compute is constrained by limited bandwidth, high latency, and uneven topology. We propose making the network an active participant in training. On the systems side, such networks should leverage (i) multicast technology to replicate outbound traffic and (ii) in-line FPGAs to aggregate inbound traffic, to ease egress and ingress bottlenecks. These technologies are used for training across workers within a data center, but this paper extends them to the WAN. On the algorithms side, we develop an optimization framework that produces rich synchronization schedules (namely, rotating cliques of islands) around the underlying network topology and these technologies, to maximize information exchange. translated_title: 使用智能网络的分布式训练
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26453v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：跨广域网（WAN）进行分布式训练具有挑战性，因为计算孤岛之间的持续参数交换受到有限带宽、高延迟和不均匀拓扑的限制。我们提出让网络成为训练中的主动参与者。在系统方面，此类网络应利用（i）多播技术复制出站流量和（ii）内联FPGA聚合入站流量，以缓解出口和入口瓶颈。这些技术用于数据中心内工作节点间的训练，但本文将其扩展到广域网。在算法方面，我们开发了一个优化框架，围绕底层网络拓扑和这些技术生成丰富的同步调度（即岛屿的旋转团），以最大化信息交换。最后，我们在基于DoubleZero网络（一个配备两者的实时可编程广域网）的九城市拓扑上进行了演示。
tldr: 本文提出利用网络中的多播和FPGA技术，并开发优化调度框架，使广域网成为分布式训练的主动参与者，以克服带宽和延迟限制，最大化信息交换。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes leveraging multicast and FPGA technologies in the network, along with an optimization scheduling framework, to make the WAN an active participant in distributed training, overcoming bandwidth and latency constraints to maximize information exchange.
